name: SQL Clusters

evidence.sql: C02: managed relational SQL database hosting is the primary type; D01: native MySQL 5.7 and 8.0

line: Managed MySQL hosting with backups, monitoring, and migration help.

free.text: 7-day app trial; paid plan needed; cancelled backups may delete after 2 months

cells.metered: MySQL Express $6.99/mo; 2 cores, 2 GB RAM, 60 GB SSD
cells.regions: Dallas, Kansas City, Bend; location lists conflict
cells.selfhost: No, this is the managed MySQL service

sql.math: One monthly Express subscription costs $6.99. 1 GB of data and 10 connections fit within the listed storage and default limits.
The subscription stays at $6.99 a month with no queries. No idle discount is published.

files.math: SQL Clusters does not provide file storage.

jobs.math: SQL Clusters does not provide worker jobs
